primary_metric: Mean return over all three nonidentity shifts within training seed, paired differences across five seeds
statistics: Paired mean and t95 interval; exact two-sided sign-flip p, Holm over five primary contrasts. Five units cannot yield exact two-sided p below 0.0625; no guarantee of significance.
scope: Predeclared frozen-policy robustness evaluation on controlled partner-policy transforms and fresh rollout seeds. Existing training datasets and checkpoints; not new training seeds, new task, or unseen agent identity. No fine-tuning or selection from these results.
